Mermaid: erDiagram
content.diagram_html:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
    <defs>
        <script type="application/mermaid+json">{
            "code": "erDiagram
    Users ||--o{ Orders : places
    Users ||--o{ Reviews : writes
    Orders ||--o{ OrderItems : contains
    Products ||--o{ OrderItems : appears_in
    Products ||--o{ Reviews : receives
    Products ||--o{ ProductCategories : is_categorized_as
    Categories ||--o{ ProductCategories : contains_product
    Categories }|--o{ Categories : has_parent

    Users {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) email
        VARCHAR(255) name
        DATETIME created_at
    }

    Orders {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) user_id FK
        DECIMAL(10,2) total_amount
        VARCHAR(50) status
        DATETIME created_at
    }

    Products {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) name
        TEXT description
        DECIMAL(10,2) price
        INT stock_quantity
    }

    OrderItems {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) order_id FK
        VARCHAR(255) product_id FK
        INT quantity
        DECIMAL(10,2) unit_price
    }

    Reviews {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) user_id FK
        VARCHAR(255) product_id FK
        INT rating
        TEXT comment
    }

    Categories {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) name
        VARCHAR(255) parent_id FK
    }

    ProductCategories {
        VARCHAR(255) product_id PK,FK
        VARCHAR(255) category_id PK,FK
    }",
            "theme": "default",
            "themeVariables": {
                "primaryColor": "#8B5CF6",
                "background": "#FFFFFF"
            }
        }</script>
    </defs>
    <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="400" y="300" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1F2937">
        [Mermaid Diagram - Client Render]
    </text>
</svg>
